reviewer: Codex static review (model-assisted; not an independent human review)

criteria.rationale: The trigger distinguishes non-trivial multi-file work from trivial localized reversible changes.
Goal, scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria are gathered in step one, but a dedicated inputs section is absent.
Seven steps cover architecture inspection, task decomposition, ownership/dependencies, risk, testing, rollout, rollback, and approvals.
The required plan has explicit goal, acceptance, ordered tasks, risks, verification, approvals, rollout, rollback, and unknowns.
The skill forbids implementation during planning and requires guessed paths/architecture to be labelled.
Two direct cases cover complex planning and trivial-change near misses; an edge ambiguity/dependency case is missing.

gaps: Add an edge case for unresolved architecture or cyclic dependencies.
summary: Static document review only. This score does not establish behavioral performance; runtime remains NOT_RUN.
